description: Buddy Phase 4 — Production Hardening & Intelligence Deepening. Fixes critical EUR_USD model failure, adds walk-forward backtesting, real multi-timeframe data, automated retraining pipeline, and adaptive risk scaling. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP BRAINSTORMING/RESEARCHING AND IMPROVING. DONT ASK FOR EVERY COMMAND, JUST DO. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Automated pair retraining on accuracy drift (EUR_USD critical fix)
userStories.description: As a self-improving system, when AccuracyGate blocks a pair for sustained poor accuracy, the system should automatically queue and execute retraining for that pair.
acceptanceCriteria: RetrainTrigger detects EUR_USD at 0% rolling accuracy and writes retrain_request.json
scheduled_retrain.py reads retrain_request.json and prioritizes flagged pairs
After retraining, AccuracyGate rolling window resets for the retrained pair
Retrain uses latest OANDA data (not cached stale data)
Post-retrain validation: new model must score >52% on hold-out set before replacing incumbent
If retrain fails or worsens accuracy, keep old model and log failure to observations.jsonl
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. Three pieces: (1) reset_accuracy_gate_for_pairs() clears rolling window post-retrain, (2) validate_holdout_accuracy() checks >52% on hold-out before promoting, (3) _spawn_background_retrain() in ContinuousScanner runs retrain as subprocess without blocking scan loop.

userStories.title: Walk-forward backtesting framework for model validation
userStories.description: As a trading system, I need walk-forward validation to ensure models generalize across time periods, not just on a single train/test split.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/analysis/walk_forward.py with WalkForwardValidator class
Splits data into N rolling windows: train on window K, test on window K+1
Default: 5 folds, 60-day train, 20-day test, 10-day step
Reports per-fold accuracy, Sharpe, max drawdown, and aggregate statistics
Integrated into scheduled_retrain.py: after training, run walk-forward before deployment
Model only promoted if walk-forward accuracy > 53% across all folds
Results logged to trained_data/models/walk_forward_results.json
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. src/scanner/analysis/walk_forward.py. WalkForwardValidator with rolling N folds. FoldResult tracks accuracy/Sharpe/drawdown per fold. Rejects random predictors (50.3% < 53%). Persists to walk_forward_results.json.

userStories.title: Real multi-timeframe data fetching (H4/D1 from OANDA)
userStories.description: As a trading system, multi-timeframe analysis should use real H4 and D1 candle data, not synthetic approximations from H1.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify _evaluate_multi_timeframe in agents/_team.py to fetch real H4 and D1 data from OANDA
Cache H4/D1 data per pair per scan cycle (avoid redundant API calls)
Cache expires after 4 hours for H4, 24 hours for D1
Graceful fallback: if OANDA fetch fails, use existing H1 synthesis (don't block scan)
Multi-timeframe agent calculates real trend alignment across H1/H4/D1
Add multi_timeframe_data_source field to agent verdict metadata (real vs synthetic)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. _evaluate_multi_timeframe in agents/_team.py now fetches real H4 (4h cache) and D1 (24h cache) from OANDA via get_candles(). Falls back to H1 synthesis on failure. metadata.multi_timeframe_data_source tracks real vs synthetic.

userStories.title: Adaptive risk scaling based on recent performance
userStories.description: As a risk management system, position sizing should scale down after losses and scale up after confirmed winning streaks.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/risk/adaptive_scaler.py with AdaptiveRiskScaler class
After 3 consecutive losses: reduce position size by 30% (drawdown protection)
After 5 consecutive wins with consistent accuracy: increase size by 15% (up to base max)
Scale factor stored in state and persists across sessions
Scale factor decays toward 1.0 (baseline) over 48 hours if no trades
Integrated into position_sizing.py: multiply base risk by scale factor
Log all scale changes to observations.jsonl with category 'risk_scaling'
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. src/risk/adaptive_scaler.py. 3 losses=0.70x, 5 losses=0.50x floor. Win streak recovery. 48h time decay toward baseline. Persists state. Wired into position_sizing.py + continuous.py learning loop.

userStories.title: Feature importance analysis and pruning per pair
userStories.description: As a learning system, I should know which features matter most for each pair and prune noisy features to improve model accuracy.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/training/feature_analysis.py with FeatureAnalyzer class
Uses permutation importance on trained models to rank features per pair
Identifies features with importance < 0.01 (noise) and importance > 0.1 (critical)
Generates trained_data/models/feature_importance.json with per-pair rankings
Optional: prune bottom 10% features during next retrain cycle
Integrated into scheduled_retrain.py: run feature analysis after each retrain
Log top 5 and bottom 5 features per pair to learnings.md
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. src/training/feature_analysis.py. Permutation importance with n_repeats=5. Correctly identifies signal vs noise features. Persists to feature_importance.json. get_prune_list() returns noise features for retraining.

userStories.title: Trade correlation and clustering analysis
userStories.description: As a learning system, I should detect when multiple trades cluster in the same conditions and avoid repeated exposure to the same market setup.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/analysis/trade_clustering.py with TradeClusterAnalyzer class
Clusters recent trades by regime, session, direction, and confidence band
Detects when 3+ trades share the same cluster profile within 24 hours
Applies -10% confidence penalty for trades matching an active losing cluster
Applies +5% confidence boost for trades matching an active winning cluster
Cluster analysis runs during scan, stored in memory (not persisted — lightweight)
Log cluster detections to observations.jsonl with category 'trade_cluster'
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. src/scanner/analysis/trade_clustering.py. Clusters by (pair, direction, regime, session, conf_band). 3+ losses in cluster = -10% penalty. 3+ wins = +5% boost. Wired into engine.py after backtest gate. Prunes entries > 24h.
